description: This file defines the BeanManager class within the Api\V8\BeanDecorator namespace, which acts as a manager and utility for handling SugarBean objects including creation, retrieval, relationship management, and counting records. It provides encapsulated methods for safe bean operations, relationship handling, and field filtering specifically for Person objects.

classes.name: BeanManager
classes.description: A class providing management operations for SugarBean objects within the CRM, including creation, retrieval, relationship management, and record counting, with safety checks and exception handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the BeanManager with a database manager and bean aliases.

methods.name: newBeanSafe
methods.description: Creates a new SugarBean object for a given module safely, considering bean aliases and validating module existence.

methods.name: getBean
methods.description: Retrieves a SugarBean object by module and optional ID, with support for additional parameters and deletion flag.

methods.name: getBeanSafe
methods.description: Safely retrieves a SugarBean object by module and ID, throwing exceptions if not found or invalid.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a BeanListRequest object for a specified module.

methods.name: createRelationshipSafe
methods.description: Creates a relationship between two SugarBean objects safely, with exception handling on failure.

methods.name: deleteRelationshipSafe
methods.description: Deletes a relationship between two SugarBean objects safely, with exception handling on failure.

methods.name: getLinkedFieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the link field name between two SugarBean objects based on relationship metadata.

methods.name: getLinkedFieldBean
methods.description: Fetches the related bean for a given source bean and link field name.

methods.name: countRecords
methods.description: Counts the number of records for a module satisfying a specified where condition.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns default field names for a given SugarBean.

methods.name: filterAcceptanceFields
methods.description: Filters a list of fields based on Person bean definitions and link type, applicable only to Person objects.
